blocks.html:
This method defines a relationship between two data models,
where the owner of the relationship has many records of the related
data model, but the related data model only has one owner.

For example, a store "hasMany" products.

```ts
import { model } from "@medusajs/framework/utils"

const Store = model.define("store", {
  id: model.id(),
  products: model.hasMany(() => Product),
})
```

types.name: T
types.description:
The type of the entity builder passed as a first parameter. By default, it's
a function returning the related model.

types.name: entityBuilder
types.description: A function that returns the data model this model is related to.

children.name: mappedBy
children.description:
The name of the relationship as defined in the other
data model. This is only required by the `belongsTo` and `manyToMany`
relationship method.
